summary: UC2: Member receives push notification and navigates to RSVP

ios.note: OS push received + tap-nav on device

android.note: OS push received + tap-nav on device

user_story: As a network or community member, I want to tap an event push notification and land directly on the RSVP page, so I can commit to attending in one action.
preconditions: User has push notifications enabled on their device
Admin has triggered an event creation push for an audience that includes this user
entry_points: A. Push notification tapped on mobile device

push_payload._source: Tanat Tangun dev note (PDT-3677 comment 2026-07-10) — route off data payload, no path/deeplink string sent
push_payload.eventId: event public id — use to open the RSVP page
push_payload.communityId: community public id — community avatar/icon client-rendered from this
push_payload.eventStartTime: ISO-8601 instant, e.g. 2026-07-10T13:00:00.000Z — for client-side re-localization
push_payload.eventTimezone: IANA name, e.g. "Asia/Kathmandu" — present ONLY if the event has one

os_notification_text.title: {CommunityName} has event {EventName}
os_notification_text._qa_flag: server renders time → must honor EVENT timezone (PM: follow event tz, TR-CL-05). BUG-B2: push reads rawData.timezone (top-level) but tz stored at metadata.timezone → risks UTC. Verify displayed push time = event tz, not UTC/device.

notes: Virtual events → EXACTLY ONE push. Auto-created Room's go-live push is suppressed for event-linked rooms; no client-side dedup needed.
Disabled push (toggle off, master off, or OS-level opt-out) does NOT affect the in-app tray — tray items still appear. Push and tray are independent.

Deleted event: opening a deleted event (GET events/{eventId}) returns 404 → render "This event is no longer available", not error/blank. NOTE: shared tray nav — Android currently shows "This community is private" for deleted (BUG-C) → verify on push tap too.
Additive only — no breaking changes to existing endpoints (new push type + new data fields).

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Tap navigates to event RSVP page
given: A user receives an event creation push notification
then: They are navigated to that event's RSVP page (= event detail page where RSVP is visible)

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Event deleted before user taps push
given: An event creation push was sent
The event is deleted (isDeleted = true) before the user taps
acceptance_criteria.when: The user taps the push notification
then: They see "This event is no longer available"
They are NOT shown an error or blank screen
(QA: GET events/{eventId} returns 404 → maps to the unavailable message; watch Android BUG-C conflation)

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Push suppressed by device-level notification settings
given: A user has disabled push notifications at the device or OS level
acceptance_criteria.when: An event creation push is triggered for their audience segment
then: They do NOT receive the push
They still receive the in-app tray notification per existing behavior

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Virtual event — no duplicate push from auto-generated Room
given: An event is a virtual event (Room auto-generated on creation)
acceptance_criteria.when: The admin sends the event creation push
then: Only ONE push notification is delivered to each eligible user
The Room/livestream-creation push notification is suppressed
(Per existing rule: SDD RSVP to Events & Event Reminders, UC4)

given: An event creation push is sent
acceptance_criteria.when: The push is displayed on the device
then: The push title reads "{{CommunityName}} has event {{EventName}}"
The push body shows an event type chip ("In-person" or "Virtual") followed by the event start date and start time
The notification icon displays the community avatar
(QA: start time rendered in EVENT timezone per TR-CL-05; watch BUG-B2 UTC)
